Q: How can I insert specific index in array using lodash? A:

Currently lodash not have that. You can use this alternate

arr.splice(index, 0, item);


const arr = [
  {name: 'john'},
  {name: 'jane'},
  {name: 'saske'},
  {name: 'jake'},
  {name: 'baki'} 
]

arr.splice(2, 0, {name: 'ace'})

console.log(arr)

Q: How do I put div classes in SQL statement? A:

Try this

div {  padding:10px; background-color:red; color: white;  }

group_concat('<div>', title, '</div>', '<div>', start_date, '</div>', '<div>', location, '</div>' ORDER BY title DESC SEPARATOR '<br>') as data FROM events

Or

.cls {  padding:10px; background-color:red; color: white;  }

group_concat('<div class="cls">', title, '</div>', '<div>', start_date, '</div>', '<div>', location, '</div>' ORDER BY title DESC SEPARATOR '<br>') as data FROM events
